The methodology describes country random effects while the selected table notes say country dummy variables are included; robust standard errors are reported without correction or clustering details.

evidence.quote: negative of the absolute value of the analyst forecast error, deflated by stock price
evidence.description: The paper defines forecast accuracy as negative absolute forecast error divided by stock price.

evidence.description: Historical returns-earnings correlation uses a three-year window.

evidence.description: Earnings surprise uses current and prior-year EPS and stock price.
